lane.title: Selected-At-Random Completeness-Decontaminated Crustal-Scarp-Drainage & Coulomb-Relay Submodular Discovery
lane.method_paragraph: Model unmapped geothermal-indicative faults via the exact Selected-At-Random missingness decomposition q_new(x) = (1 - c_hat(x)) * P_SAR_phys(F=1 | X_Delta(x)) + c_hat(x) * P_relay(F_new=1 | X_Delta(x), X_vis(x)), where X_Delta comprises strictly translation-invariant local geophysical, geomorphic, drainage-knickpoint, and hydrothermal differential operators (reusing cached 44-layer physics.py stack plus 20 new multi-scale scarp-asymmetry, bajada-flexure, chi-knickpoint, Blakely up-dip gravity-crest, Salem magnetic tilt-contact, and detrended GeoDAWN uranium-redox channels, excluding sgmc_logdist and raw regional DC potential fields from the far-field head), c_hat(x) = exp(-(d_vis(x)/18.0)^2) is the fold-visible quadrangle mapping-completeness propensity, P_SAR_phys is cross-fit out-of-fold with inverse-completeness weighting, and discrete {0,1} dots are emitted via exact Dinkelbach fractional programming (vendor/gems57/emit.py::dinkelbach_allocate) at kernel-efficient spacing s = 2.65 px outside the 200 m (2 px) zero-credit catalogue collar.
lane.named_non_fault_mimic: Wave-cut Pleistocene pluvial Lake Lahontan (~1,330 m) and Lake Bonneville (~1,555 m) shoreline scarps, coalescing alluvial-fan channel incision risers, evaporite playa clay-pan margins (cond_surf), and GeoDAWN airborne magnetic flight-line leveling seams.
